intent: MemoryStore is the outbound port of the memory context: summary, recent messages, overflow messages and applied-turn lookups, all scoped by session id and tenant id. It has no framework types and is bound by R2dbcMemoryStore.

methods.signature: Flux<ContextEntry> recentMessages(String sessionId, String tenantId, int limit)
methods.semantics: limit must be > 0; at most limit newest messages

methods.signature: Flux<ContextEntry> overflowMessages(String sessionId, String tenantId, int keep)
methods.semantics: keep must be > 0; messages older than the newest keep

methods.signature: Mono<Boolean> turnApplied(String sessionId, String turnId, String tenantId)
methods.semantics: true when the turn was already applied for this session and tenant (duplicate, caller skips); false when not yet applied (caller proceeds)
